parameters.jsCode: const auth = $json.headers?.authorization; if (auth !== `Bearer ${$env.N8N_HOMEFIX_SECRET}`) throw new Error('Unauthorized'); const body = $json.body ?? {}; if (!body.repairNeedId || !body.description) throw new Error('Invalid HomeFix payload'); return [{ json: body }];

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { model: $env.HOMEFIX_AI_MODEL || 'gpt-4.1-mini', messages: [{ role: 'system', content: 'You provide conservative preliminary home-repair triage, never a diagnosis. Return only JSON with repairCategory, urgency, summary, observations, safetyFlags, followUpQuestions, confidence.' }, { role: 'user', content: [{ type: 'text', text: JSON.stringify({ description: $json.description, reportedCategory: $json.reportedCategory, gettingWorse: $json.gettingWorse, safeToOccupy: $json.safeToOccupy }) }, ...($json.imageUrls || []).map(url => ({ type: 'image_url', image_url: { url } }))] }], response_format: { type: 'json_object' }, temperature: 0.1 } }}

parameters.jsCode: const content = $json.choices?.[0]?.message?.content; if (!content) throw new Error('AI response missing content'); const value = JSON.parse(content); const allowedCategories = ['roof_water_intrusion','hvac','plumbing','electrical','windows_doors','accessibility','lead_environmental','structural','other']; const allowedUrgencies = ['low','moderate','high','critical']; if (!allowedCategories.includes(value.repairCategory) || !allowedUrgencies.includes(value.urgency) || typeof value.summary !== 'string' || !Array.isArray(value.observations) || !Array.isArray(value.safetyFlags) || !Array.isArray(value.followUpQuestions) || typeof value.confidence !== 'number') throw new Error('AI response failed HomeFix contract'); return [{ json: value }];
